displayName: GHADV-3373: Keycloak: Open redirect when using wildcard valid redirect URIs in Keycloak
description:
Keycloak: Open redirect when using wildcard valid redirect URIs in Keycloak

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_redirect_ghadv_3373", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%keycloak%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%open%') AND "value" > 0
